cards.back: To put numbers together to find a bigger number. 3 add 2 is 5.
cards.say: Add. To put numbers together to find a bigger number. Three add two is five.

cards.back: The word for the + sign. 4 + 1 is read four plus one.
cards.say: Plus. The word for the plus sign. Four plus one is read four plus one.

cards.back: The number you get when you add things together. The total of 6 and 3 is 9.
cards.say: Total. The number you get when you add things together. The total of six and three is nine.

cards.back: All of the things counted together. 2 cats and 3 dogs make 5 animals altogether.
cards.say: Altogether. All of the things counted together. Two cats and three dogs make five animals altogether.

cards.back: To remove some from a group. 7 take away 2 is 5.
cards.say: Take away. To remove some from a group. Seven take away two is five.

cards.back: Another word for take away. 9 subtract 4 is 5.
cards.say: Subtract. Another word for take away. Nine subtract four is five.

cards.back: Has the same value as. 5 + 5 equals 10. The sign is =.
cards.say: Equals. Has the same value as. Five plus five equals ten.

cards.back: Finding the gap between two numbers. 8 is 3 more than 5.
cards.say: How many more? Finding the gap between two numbers. Eight is three more than five.

cards.back: A smaller number of things you can count. 3 apples is fewer than 5 apples.
cards.say: Fewer. A smaller number of things you can count. Three apples is fewer than five apples.

cards.back: Bigger than. 9 is greater than 6.
cards.say: Greater than. Bigger than. Nine is greater than six.

cards.back: Smaller than. 4 is less than 7.
cards.say: Less than. Smaller than. Four is less than seven.

cards.back: One of the symbols 0 to 9 used to write numbers. 15 has two digits, 1 and 5.
cards.say: Digit. One of the symbols zero to nine used to write numbers. Fifteen has two digits, one and five.

cards.back: Places in a number. In 14 the 1 is a ten and the 4 is 4 ones.
cards.say: Tens and ones. Places in a number. In fourteen the one is a ten and the four is four ones.

cards.back: Twice as many. Double 3 is 6.
cards.say: Double. Twice as many. Double three is six.

cards.back: One of 2 equal parts. Half of 10 is 5.
cards.say: Half. One of two equal parts. Half of ten is five.

cards.back: A number that cannot be shared into 2 equal groups, such as 9.
cards.say: Odd. A number that cannot be shared into two equal groups, such as nine.

cards.back: A number that can be shared into 2 equal groups, such as 8.
cards.say: Even. A number that can be shared into two equal groups, such as eight.

cards.back: Start at a number and count up from it. To add 6 + 2, start at 6 and say 7, 8.
cards.say: Count on. Start at a number and count up from it. To add six plus two, start at six and say seven, eight.

cards.back: Start at a number and count down from it. 9 take away 3: say 8, 7, 6.
cards.say: Count back. Start at a number and count down from it. Nine take away three: say eight, seven, six.

cards.back: A line with numbers in order, used for counting on and back.
cards.say: Number line. A line with numbers in order, used for counting on and back.

cards.back: A group of 2 things. A pair of shoes is 2 shoes.
cards.say: Pair. A group of two things. A pair of shoes is two shoes.

cards.back: To put numbers or things in a line, from smallest to biggest or biggest to smallest.
cards.say: Order. To put numbers or things in a line, from smallest to biggest or biggest to smallest.

cards.back: Things that repeat in the same way again and again.
cards.say: Pattern. Things that repeat in the same way again and again.

cards.back: Longer means more length. Shorter means less length.
cards.say: Longer and shorter. Longer means more length. Shorter means less length.

cards.back: Heavier means weighs more. Lighter means weighs less.
cards.say: Heavier and lighter. Heavier means weighs more. Lighter means weighs less.
